verdict.rationale: Omnara supports organization/project structures with role-based access (manage, configure, operate, view) assigned to users and API keys, implying some administrative control over others' agent usage, but there is no explicit evidence of a lead directly creating or launching a session under another user's identity. missing for 10: explicit 'create session on behalf of' workflow, documentation of delegated session ownership, and confirmation that leads can operate agents as/for teammates.
